game_title: Fallback: Frequency Bazaar – Cloud Sea Overlook
game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook, an overlook above the clouds: the mountaineer must hold off avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Frequency Bazaar: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook: an overlook above the clouds
core_gameplay_loop: In Cloud Sea Overlook, repeat each round: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary. Then check tally and advance.
player_objective: Protect the cliff anchor from avalanches in Cloud Sea Overlook: keep tally above zero until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Frequency Bazaar
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 8, Level 9, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

Survive for 43 seconds to complete the level.
